- 落命令证据：`build_exec_command` 注入 `-c mcp_servers.ipybox.enabled=true/false`（[dispatch_v2.py](/E:/codex-LOOP/codex-loop-s-f2/harness/dispatch_v2.py:429)、[headless_wave.py](/E:/codex-LOOP/codex-loop-s-f2/harness/headless_wave.py:271)），spawn 事件 detail 再按命令串记录 `ipybox_enabled`（[dispatch_v2.py](/E:/codex-LOOP/codex-loop-s-f2/harness/dispatch_v2.py:519)）。Desktop 侧 `.codex/config.toml` 根本没有 `[mcp_servers.ipybox]` 块（缺省即关闭），与 [config.toml.example](/E:/codex-LOOP/codex-loop-s-f2/config/config.toml.example:87) 注释“Desktop control plane；headless dispatch overrides true per worker”一致。
- 测试已锁定该矩阵：[test_dispatch_v2.py](/E:/codex-LOOP/codex-loop-s-f2/tests/test_dispatch_v2.py:295)（Desktop 全关 / WSL worker 开 / K3 默认关 / K3 例外仅 WSL）、[test_headless_wave.py](/E:/codex-LOOP/codex-loop-s-f2/tests/unit/test_headless_wave.py:116)、[test_dispatch_model_pin.py](/E:/codex-LOOP/codex-loop-s-f2/tests/unit/test_dispatch_model_pin.py:71)。
